data.title: Bitcoin keeps traders guessing near $64K as stocks gain on cool US PPI data
data.description: Bitcoin (BTC) edged away from weekly lows on Thursday after the US Producer Price Index (PPI) narrowly cooled in July.Key points:July PPI extends cooler US inflation trendBITSTAMP:BTCUSD was up around 0.5% on the day near $63,900 with volatility broadly absent, data from TradingView showed.BITSTAMP…
